item.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak persists as death toll exceeds 3,000
item.description: Recent government figures indicate the Ebola outbreak in Congo has claimed over 3,000 lives among more than 6,100 confirmed cases.

item.title: Markey wins Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary over Moulton
item.description: Incumbent Senator Ed Markey has secured the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts.

item.title: Times Square stabbing victim identified as Bank of America employee
item.description: Erin Piacenti was named as one of two people stabbed by a woman in Times Square on Monday afternoon; police fatally shot the suspect.

item.title: AP projects Markey to beat Moulton in Massachusetts Democratic primary
item.description: Markey, an 80-year-old progressive, defeated Rep. Seth Moulton, a 47-year-old moderate from the New Democrat Coalition.
